detail.longDescription: 🤖 UpgradePilot: open-source autonomous vulnerability response agent. Investigates CVEs, proves exploitability in a sandbox, generates and verifies patches, then requests human approval before opening a remediation PR. New project, interesting direction for automated patching. 🔗 https:// github.com/oussamaelfig/Upgrad ePilot # CyberSec # AI # CVE # OpenSource
